nodes.label: GLUE Cloud
nodes.rationale: Optional Cloudflare Worker service (D1, Durable Object) holding account collections (never music), profiles, and devices. Enables optional cloud sync and signaling for device connections. User controls whether to use it.

nodes.label: Music Library
nodes.rationale: Collection of music tracks with metadata, organized into profiles (artist aliases), collections, music folders, DJ libraries, playlists, and events. One row per song showing best copy. Library data stored as JSON in GLUE folder (mco.json, profiles, collections).

nodes.label: Native Analysis Engine
nodes.rationale: Rust-based audio analysis in GLUE Home (crates/glue-audio). Produces verdict (quality), tier, bandwidth, bit depth, BPM, key. Runs analysis queue with deadline control, handles multiple formats including DSD and ALAC.

nodes.label: Local Link
nodes.rationale: HTTP bridge at 127.0.0.1:47400-47409 from GLUE Home to browser on same computer. Provides /hello (identity), /fs/* (disk access), /cache, /rpc (engine), /lease, etc. Requires token. Stopped state answers only GLUE Home's own windows.
